t0.description: The layer whose texture_unit is 0, sampled at its own uv.

definition.notes: Plus a specular term added after lighting: n = 64*t1.x, spec = pow(saturate(N.H), n)*(n + 2)/8, F = t1.y + (1 - t1.y)*(1 - saturate(L.H))^5, colour += spec*F*specular colour*saturate(N.L)*0.8*distance falloff. Diffuse lighting is half-Lambert (saturate(0.5*N.L + 0.5)*0.8). No 12.1.0 content uses it.
